what: N cards pinned at the center of the panel flow along a curved line — during the first 80% of scroll progress the center slot moves 0 → N−1, and a card l slots away from the center shifts sideways by .78l + .18l² (card width = .78) · back .52l, rotates on the Y axis by −.32 rad × slot and scales to 1 − .12l, and beyond 3~4 slots (1.9~2.7 slots depending on progress) it recedes 4 back and fades out. From when the plate reaches 50% of the screen until it attaches, cards come in .07 later per slot, rotating half a turn from back 6, in the last 20% they leave the same way, starting from the last card. Values follow at .18 per frame (scrub .3)

options.exit: Progress at which fading begins, default .8

note: CSS 3D (perspective = card width ÷ .78 × 3.6) gives the same layout as the original three.js reel. With reduced motion, cards are not pinned and sit in a single horizontal row

from.where: index.html .kf (featured reel) — original Featured/reel: fixed 60·N %, EXIT_START .8, x = sign·(.78l + .18l²), z = −.52l − (1 − fade)·4, rotY −.32·slot, size max(.1, 1 − .12l), fade smoothstep(3→1.9, 4→2.7), entrance .07·i / .3 easeOutCubic, lerp .18
